description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by graph-0025. AGSC-03-11, AGSC-05-16 and AGSC-05-27 all map an inline Markdown link between two items of the Bundle to an untyped `asc:mentions` edge, and no vector cited it until rc.6 (ENG3-S3); the reference engine emitted none, which AGSC-00-03 makes a defect of the engine and not of the rules. Derivation: `alpha`'s body carries two inline links to `beta` and one to a heading of its own page. Two references between one pair of items produce ONE triple — the edge is between items, not between occurrences — the self-reference produces none, and the edge has no computed inverse (AGSC-03-04 lists the inverses and `mentions` is not among them). Only the mentions lines are asserted here: the rest of the serialisation is pinned by graph-0015 to graph-0018, and this file deliberately does not claim to be a complete N-Quads document (the fault graph-0010 was withdrawn for).

items.body: See [Beta](../concepts/beta/) and again [Beta](../concepts/beta/), and this page's [own section](#s).

reason: AGSC-04-15 was amended at rc.6 (PY2-01) to pin the graph term of every line of graph.nq as the Bundle IRI; this case states its lines as triples in the default graph, which that rule now excludes. The corrected case ships as graph-0025 (AGSC-00-16: a released vector is never edited in place).
